keyMappings:
# Alt+1..8 go to tab N and Alt+9 to the last tab, like Firefox does.
# Vimium takes the key first, so sites like Teams that bind Alt+N never see it.
map <a-1> firstTab count=1
map <a-2> firstTab count=2
map <a-3> firstTab count=3
map <a-4> firstTab count=4
map <a-5> firstTab count=5
map <a-6> firstTab count=6
map <a-7> firstTab count=7
map <a-8> firstTab count=8
map <a-9> lastTab
